resources.string: Press the power button 5 times within 10 seconds to bring up the panic confirmation. It only listens during your watch window, and nothing is sent until you tap Yes. It is on now; turn it off here if drills show it fires by accident.
Listening now: your watch window is active.
Not listening: no watch window is active.
Not listening: the gesture is off. The Panic button still works.
Listening for 5 power presses during your watch window.
Tap to confirm or cancel the panic alert.
